<assessment>SOURCE shows one street oblique: a gridded tower stepping toward a lower left wing, planted terrace pockets, recessed outdoor bays, a darker lower facade zone, glazed street frontage, and a right neighbor with punched windows and a vegetated end wall. CURRENT contains these principal elements. Image 10 confirms a full-bay loggia with a floor, return and guard; the earlier interpretation of all recesses as shallow slots is no longer conclusive. Other recess locations and street-level transparency remain unverified. The strongest remaining differences are the low-wing terrace articulation and neighboring window arrangement. SOURCE does not establish the rear elevations or complete roof plan. No definite slab penetration, floating guard or building–plant collision is demonstrated.</assessment>
<issue priority="1" view="source-matched left-wing overview">problem: SOURCE’s low-wing terraces form staggered planted pockets with substantial enclosing edges. CURRENT image 9 still shows small ledges and isolated planting boxes beside a broad exposed connector surface, weakening the visible stepped assembly.
action: Locally adjust the existing terrace floors, returns and perimeter edges to form the source-visible layered pockets. Preserve demonstrated connections and keep slabs clear of enclosure walls; leave concealed roof areas inferred.</issue>
<issue priority="2" view="front">problem: The right neighbor has too many tightly repeated window rows. SOURCE shows a small upper row followed by taller, vertically articulated openings; CURRENT repeats shallow upper rows and a dense square-window matrix.
action: Locally revise the visible window count, heights and spacing to match SOURCE’s row hierarchy. Retain the dark ground openings and vegetated far-right end wall.</issue>
<keep>
Projecting pale facade members and recessed glazing reveals visible in image 10.
The inspected full-bay loggia’s floor, side return and perimeter guard.
The neighboring building’s dark ground-floor openings and vegetated end-wall zone.
</keep>
